content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To make tofu french toast, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Blend the silken tofu until completely smooth (2 minutes)
Step 2. Measure out the nutritional yeast (30 seconds)
Step 3. Grate fresh nutmeg into a small bowl (1 minute)
Step 4. Whisk in the ground cinnamon (45 seconds)
Step 5. Set out the serving plates (1 minute)
Step 6. Pour the soy milk into the blender (30 seconds)
Step 7. Add a pinch of sea salt (15 seconds)
Step 8. Open a new container of maple syrup (1 minute)
Step 9. Sift the chickpea flour to remove lumps (3 minutes)
Step 10. Prepare the fruit garnish (5 minutes)
Step 11. Locate the vanilla bean paste (2 minutes)
Step 12. Mix the turmeric into the liquid base for color (1 minute)
Step 13. Rinse the measuring spoons (1 minute)
Step 14. Add the nutritional yeast to the tofu mixture (30 seconds)
Step 15. Incorporate the grated nutmeg (30 seconds)
Step 16. Clean the prep counter (5 minutes)
Step 17. Stir the batter one last time (30 seconds)
Step 18. Check the expiration date on the bread (1 minute)
Step 19. Preheat the non-stick griddle (4 minutes)
Step 20. Arrange the bread slices on a cutting board (2 minutes)
Step 21. Wipe down the stove backsplash (3 minutes)
Step 22. Measure the agave nectar (1 minute)
Step 23. Add the vanilla bean paste to the mix (30 seconds)
Step 24. Slice the sourdough loaf into thick rounds (3 minutes)
Step 25. Light the gas burner (10 seconds)
Step 26. Select a spatula for flipping (30 seconds)
Step 27. Soften the vegan butter at room temperature (10 minutes)
Step 28. Whisk the batter vigorously to aerate (2 minutes)
Step 29. Pour the batter into a wide, shallow dish (1 minute)
Step 30. Melt a small knob of butter on the griddle (2 minutes)
Step 31. Set the timer for soaking (30 seconds)
Step 32. Shake the cinnamon bottle (15 seconds)
Step 33. Find the whisk in the utensil drawer (1 minute)
Step 34. Pulse the blender to combine all liquids (15 seconds)
Step 35. Add a dash of cardamom (30 seconds)
Step 36. Dip the first slice of bread into the batter (20 seconds)
Step 37. Soak the bread for thirty seconds per side (1 minute)
Step 38. Clear away the flour bags (2 minutes)
Step 39. Place the soaked bread onto the hot griddle (15 seconds)
Step 40. Wash your hands thoroughly (40 seconds)
Step 41. Adjust the heat to medium-low (10 seconds)
Step 42. Measure the almond extract (30 seconds)
Step 43. Clean the whisk (2 minutes)
Step 44. Take the bread out of the pantry (1 minute)
Step 45. Scrape the sides of the blender jar (45 seconds)
Step 46. Check the bottom of the toast for browning (1 minute)
Step 47. Pour maple syrup into a small serving pitcher (1 minute)
Step 48. Sift a little cornstarch into the batter (1 minute)
Step 49. Get the spices out of the cabinet (2 minutes)
Step 50. Pour the finished batter into a secondary bowl (1 minute)
Step 51. Retrieve the turmeric from the spice rack (1 minute)
Step 52. Set the maple syrup on the dining table (1 minute)
Step 53. Slice the crusts off if desired (2 minutes)
Step 54. Put the bread bag tie back on (15 seconds)
Step 55. Flip the french toast carefully (30 seconds)
Step 56. Open the package of firm silken tofu (1 minute)
Step 57. Butter the hot toast slices (45 seconds)
Step 58. Measure out the soy milk (1 minute)
Step 59. Get a large mixing bowl (1 minute)
Step 60. Cook the second side until golden brown (3 minutes)
Step 61. Grease the griddle surface (30 seconds)
Step 62. Soften the coconut oil (5 minutes)
Step 63. Drain the excess water from the tofu (2 minutes)
Step 64. Pour out the remaining batter (30 seconds)
Step 65. Knife-trim the edges of the bread (2 minutes)
Step 66. Wash the vanilla measuring spoon (1 minute)
Step 67. Transfer the toast to a warm plate (30 seconds)
Step 68. Put the spatula in the sink (15 seconds)
Step 69. Dry the almond extract spoon (30 seconds)
Step 70. Gather all liquid ingredients (3 minutes)
Step 71. Garnish with fresh berries (1 minute)
Step 72. Dust the toast with powdered sugar (45 seconds)
Step 73. Warm the plates in the oven (5 minutes)
Step 74. Slice the bread on a diagonal (1 minute)
Step 75. Drizzle with the prepared maple syrup (30 seconds)
Step 76. Melt the vegan butter in a small pan (2 minutes)
Step 77. Serve the tofu french toast immediately (1 minute)
Step 78. Plug in the electric blender (15 seconds)
Step 79. Sift the dry ingredients together (2 minutes)
Step 80. Clean the cutting board (2 minutes)
